Class ScenarioSpatialBoundsSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioSpatialBoundsSectionBuilder
public class ScenarioSpatialBoundsSectionBuilder extends Object
UI Section Builder for geographical clipping, bounding box constraints, and boundary condition modeling.

Enables bounded regional or continental simulations by restricting cellular computations to a spatial window $[\text{Lat}_{\min}, \text{Lat}_{\max}] \times [\text{Lng}_{\min}, \text{Lng}_{\max}]$ and configuring boundary flow physics (Dynamic Reservoir, Closed Barrier, or Periodic Toroidal Wrap).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
